reasons: Lake identity confirms case_name "National Treasury Employees Union v. Von Raab", court "U.S. Supreme Court", date_decided "1989-03-21", and year 1989.
Lake citations confirm official cite "489 U.S. 656", vendor-neutral cite "1989 U.S. LEXIS 6033", and the listed parallel citations.
The opinion expressly frames the case as a Fourth Amendment special-needs balancing case beyond ordinary law enforcement.
The opinion applies and refines that rule to suspicionless Customs employee drug testing, and the lake progeny fields show substantial later citation activity supporting a key-case role.
residual_risks: The files do not define the corpus's home-role taxonomy, so this review verifies support from the disclosed opinion and lake metadata only.

defect.evidence_quote: We hold that the testing of these employees is reasonable under the Fourth Amendment.
defect.problem: The core holding is supported, but the asserted holding field is truncated and incomplete because it ends with "under the…" instead of stating the legal standard.
defect.proposed_fix: Complete the holding: "Suspicionless drug testing of Customs employees seeking drug-interdiction or firearm-carrying positions is reasonable under the Fourth Amendment." Optionally add that the classified-materials category was remanded on an inadequate record.

reasons: The opinion upholds testing for employees directly involved in drug interdiction or required to carry firearms.
The same opinion does not decide the classified-materials category and remands that part, so the holding should remain limited to the interdiction/firearm categories.
residual_risks: The ellipsis may have been intended as display truncation, but it appears in the disclosed built page as the stored holding value.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use the Court's narrower phrasing: employees who apply for promotion or transfer to positions directly involving illegal-drug interdiction or requiring firearm carrying.

reasons: Lake treatment fields match the asserted values: field_i_validity "good_law", as_of_content "1989-03-21", as_of_treatment "2026-06-30", composite_basis "migration-seed", and scope_note "Special-needs suspicionless-testing precedent; good law."
Treatment/currency is outside Lens A, so no independent treatment finding is raised.
residual_risks: Treatment merits are reserved for Lens B.
